title: Prove four downstream stock separators after a BIT chart-388 recode
body:
Each of four downstream banks lacks its first original paid departure even with all three source banks granted. Coordinate x74 separates every missing row.

## Scope and source

Keeps recoded 1496=x43 and the named source banks and contacts. The unrestored word fails 9 forward and 4 adjoint rows. The source comparator is #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; toolkit #7852 `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`. The included source manifest identifies every public dependency used.

## Reproduction

Extract `research/p104-bit388-first-downstream-cut/replay.tar.gz` into an empty directory, check its checksum manifest, and run the extracted commands. Independent coordinate and rank replays passed. Freely granting the missing row is a positive control; one paid grade-one repair already leaves margin below −0.661134 at fixed other prices. Hosted execution is separate.

## Open next questions

Change upstream stocks or the exterior contract, then check all four restored departures.

Clear1nsight prepared this result with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds for the P104 toolkit and the predecessor authors identified in the archive. [Campaign board](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19789228).
